identify: The photo model matched this to rice brown spot.
Brown spot is a major rice disease in India.

thresholds.etl: Early to late tillering: Brown spot 2-3 spots/leaf & 2-3 infected plants/ m2.

cultural: Use a resistant or moderately resistant variety.
